subject.title: Track Usage & Spend production hardening and sharing follow-ups

question: After the renderer and partial-model-history fixes land, should CodexBar sponsor native macOS sharing and the separate scalable-dashboard/share-artifact direction, and what permanent data/privacy contract should each surface keep?
rationale: Those remaining tracks add user-facing product surface and potentially meaningful UI/data-contract complexity; VISION.md reserves that class of work for maintainer sign-off. ([github.com](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/blob/main/VISION.md))

options.title: Stage correctness, then approve a narrow share contract
options.body: Merge the isolated correctness fixes first, then sponsor native sharing only for the existing local aggregate artifact and review dashboard redesign separately.

options.title: Approve only dashboard exploration
options.body: Keep sharing at copy/save while a maintainer defines the scalable roster and partial-coverage presentation before implementation.

options.title: Defer both feature tracks
options.body: Close no child work, but leave the optional product directions parked until a maintainer prioritizes them.

recommendation.title: Stage correctness, then approve a narrow share contract
recommendation.body: Merge the isolated correctness fixes first, then sponsor native sharing only for the existing local aggregate artifact and review dashboard redesign separately.

likelyOwner.reason: VISION.md makes the remaining work a repository-level product-direction decision.
